Many thanks to Alienware for sponsoring this video. To learn more about the Alienware AREA-51 Gaming Desktop, check out: http://aw.gg/digitalfoundry

Alienware's Area 51 desktop PCs combine the most powerful CPU and GPU on the planet for ultra high-end gaming. The pixel-pushing power of the RTX 5090 is beyond doubt, but to what extent are AMD's Ryzen 9000 X3D processors essential for getting the most performance out of the Nvidia beast? 1080p benchmarks show the raw potential of the X3D line, but how does that translate to demanding 4K gaming? Rich investigates.
title: Ryzen 9000 X3D CPUs: Beyond The Benchmarks, Essential For 4K Gaming? [Sponsored]
